scope: Information experiments C: Q4 convex no-signal exclusion and Q2 bounded-error second-point geometry

q4.quick_cases: Q4 v1 quick cases, 12 groups x 5 seeds = 60 paired cases
q4.full_cases: All Q4 cases in 最佳方法/数据/exposed_cases.json, 2400 paired cases; historical exposed local regression
q4.same_state: Apply the unchanged exclusion function to copies of the off-arm polygon after eligible actual observations; never modify actual off-arm state
q4.truth_access: Evaluator observers only; source truth is not passed to the solver
q4.stress: Predeclared 1000 random physical fixtures and deterministic directional/range boundary and near-collinear fixtures; not task-performance cases

q2.shared_safe_domain: Conservative three-disk domain centered in the first-station/first-bearing frame; all candidates obey the same movement upper bound
q2.prior: Actual target disk radius 1800 intersected with first bearing wedge and reception upper disk radius 1500; normal-report range >5
q2.coarse: Complete 80 conditions per error model; deterministic finite candidate and reading search, explicitly not continuous certification
q2.continuous_representatives: 20 conditions per error model: origin with all 5 budgets, other 15 first geometries at sqrt(450000) budget; all three selected methods
q2.upper_bound: Outer polygon prior and reading cells enclosed by halfwidth delta+h/2; evaluate every reading cell
q2.lower_bound: Two legal source hypotheses with a common first and second report; validate source radii, near exclusion, target disk, and angular errors
q2.numeric_limit: Double precision conservative enclosures with explicit margins; not interval-arithmetic certificates or a continuous second-point global optimum
